title: Detailed sunflower
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='petalGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE44D'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB300'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='centerGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8B5E2B'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#5C3A1A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3E2510'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Stem -->
  <rect x='47' y='55' width='6' height='40' rx='3' fill='#3E8E41'/>
  <!-- Stem highlight -->
  <rect x='49' y='55' width='2' height='38' rx='1' fill='#5DB361'/>

  <!-- Left leaf -->
  <path d='M49 72 Q30 62 20 70 Q30 78 49 76 Z' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <path d='M49 73 Q34 67 24 71' stroke='#2E7D32' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Left leaf vein -->
  <path d='M48 74 Q38 71 28 72' stroke='#7FD183' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none'/>

  <!-- Right leaf -->
  <path d='M51 80 Q70 72 80 68 Q72 80 51 84 Z' fill='#43A047'/>
  <path d='M51 81 Q64 76 76 70' stroke='#2E7D32' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M52 82 Q62 79 72 75' stroke='#7FD183' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none'/>

  <!-- Petals - outer ring -->
  <g>
    <!-- Top petals -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='6' ry='14' fill='#FFD54F'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='4' ry='10' fill='#FFE082'/>

    <!-- Upper right -->
    <ellipse cx='68' cy='18' rx='6' ry='12' transform='rotate(40 68 18)' fill='#FFCA28'/>
    <ellipse cx='68' cy='18' rx='4' ry='9' transform='rotate(40 68 18)' fill='#FFE082'/>

    <!-- Right -->
    <ellipse cx='82' cy='32' rx='6' ry='12' transform='rotate(80 82 32)' fill='#FFD54F'/>
    <ellipse cx='82' cy='32' rx='4' ry='9' transform='rotate(80 82 32)' fill='#FFE082'/>

    <!-- Lower right -->
    <ellipse cx='80' cy='50' rx='6' ry='12' transform='rotate(120 80 50)' fill='#FFCA28'/>
    <ellipse cx='80' cy='50' rx='4' ry='9' transform='rotate(120 80 50)' fill='#FFE082'/>

    <!-- Bottom right -->
    <ellipse cx='68' cy='62' rx='6' ry='11' transform='rotate(160 68 62)' fill='#FFD54F'/>
    <ellipse cx='68' cy='62' rx='4' ry='8' transform='rotate(160 68 62)' fill='#FFE082'/>

    <!-- Bottom -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='6' ry='12' fill='#FFCA28'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='4' ry='9' fill='#FFE082'/>

    <!-- Bottom left -->
    <ellipse cx='32' cy='62' rx='6' ry='11' transform='rotate(-160 32 62)' fill='#FFD54F'/>
    <ellipse cx='32' cy='62' rx='4' ry='8' transform='rotate(-160 32 62)' fill='#FFE082'/>

    <!-- Left -->
    <ellipse cx='20' cy='50' rx='6' ry='12' transform='rotate(-120 20 50)' fill='#FFCA28'/>
    <ellipse cx='20' cy='50' rx='4' ry='9' transform='rotate(-120 20 50)' fill='#FFE082'/>

    <!-- Upper left -->
    <ellipse cx='18' cy='32' rx='6' ry='12' transform='rotate(-80 18 32)' fill='#FFD54F'/>
    <ellipse cx='18' cy='32' rx='4' ry='9' transform='rotate(-80 18 32)' fill='#FFE082'/>

    <!-- Top left -->
    <ellipse cx='32' cy='18' rx='6' ry='12' transform='rotate(-40 32 18)' fill='#FFCA28'/>
    <ellipse cx='32' cy='18' rx='4' ry='9' transform='rotate(-40 32 18)' fill='#FFE082'/>

    <!-- Inner petals (shorter, brighter) -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='24' rx='5' ry='10' fill='#FFE44D'/>
    <ellipse cx='65' cy='28' rx='5' ry='9' transform='rotate(35 65 28)' fill='#FFE44D'/>
    <ellipse cx='72' cy='40' rx='5' ry='9' transform='rotate(70 72 40)' fill='#FFE44D'/>
    <ellipse cx='70' cy='52' rx='5' ry='8' transform='rotate(110 70 52)' fill='#FFE44D'/>
    <ellipse cx='62' cy='56' rx='5' ry='8' transform='rotate(150 62 56)' fill='#FFE44D'/>
    <ellipse cx='38' cy='56' rx='5' ry='8' transform='rotate(-150 38 56)' fill='#FFE44D'/>
    <ellipse cx='28' cy='50' rx='5' ry='8' transform='rotate(-110 28 50)' fill='#FFE44D'/>
    <ellipse cx='28' cy='38' rx='5' ry='9' transform='rotate(-60 28 38)' fill='#FFE44D'/>
    <ellipse cx='38' cy='28' rx='5' ry='9' transform='rotate(-25 38 28)' fill='#FFE44D'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sunflower center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='14' fill='url(#centerGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='11' fill='#6B4226'/>

  <!-- Seed pattern dots -->
  <g fill='#8B5E2B'>
    <circle cx='46' cy='34' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='34' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='37' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='52' cy='37' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='38' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='42' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='49' cy='41' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='53' cy='41' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='42' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='46' cy='46' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='46' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='49' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='52' cy='49' r='0.9'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Seed pattern light dots -->
  <g fill='#A0743F'>
    <circle cx='48' cy='35' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='52' cy='35' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='46' cy='39' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='39' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='39' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='47' cy='43' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='51' cy='43' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='55' cy='43' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='47' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='52' cy='47' r='0.8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Center highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='37' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#8B5E2B' opacity='0.4'/>
</svg>
